questions.question: What does David ask God to hide him from?
options: The false words of the prophets
The open wars of the nations
The secret plots of the wicked
The proud boasts of the kings
questions.answer: The secret plots of the wicked

questions.question: What do the wicked use as their weapon in this psalm?
options: Sharp swords, drawing them in secret
Bitter words, aiming them like arrows
Heavy stones, gathering them by night
Deep pits, digging them for the just
questions.answer: Bitter words, aiming them like arrows

questions.question: The psalm says God will shoot his arrow at the wicked, and they will be wounded.
Let the righteous one rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in him! Let all the upright in heart _____!
Then all mankind fears; they tell what God has brought about and ponder what he has _____.
